# Vendored CSDeskBand source

Core and WinForms source copied from the user-provided `CSDeskBand-2.1.0-core` checkout. Upstream: https://github.com/dsafa/CSDeskBand . Licensed under MIT; see LICENSE, which is also embedded in TaskbarMore.exe.

These files compile directly into TaskbarMore.exe. Original library projects, packaging metadata and signing key are not needed. WPF and samples are omitted. The implementation remains unchanged.
